title: Right Answer, Wrong Score: Uncovering the Inconsistencies of LLM Evaluation in Multiple-Choice Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing automated answer extraction strategies (Logprobs, RegEx, and LLM-based extractors like xFinder) against human annotations to measure systematic errors, misrepresentations, and performance underestimation in Multiple-Choice Question Answering (MCQA) benchmarks.

Evaluating how the presence or absence of output formatting constraints in prompts (e.g., Zero-Shot, Zero-Shot Chain-of-Thought, Zero-Shot with Format Constraint, and Few-Shot) systematically impacts model reasoning and the reliability of the answer extraction process.
